depends_on: source-specific policy/request/retention preflight before a bounded qualification probe; receipt/parser review before broader collection

aggregate_limits.rule: All requests including redirects count against aggregate and provider limits; allocate centrally before parallel workers start. No borrowing beyond limits; stop at first applicable cap.

frontier_order: For each county, attempt named institution project route and independent topical route where qualification and seed exist, round-robin.
Then account pages, alternating User and Organization, then independent publication/preprint and community leads.
Follow dated source relationships and unresolved gaps; do not rank by reputation, stars, recency or prior publication.

(<county> OR <campus>) (clinical imaging OR wearable OR sleep OR assistive OR public health) (software OR tool OR project)
<seed institution> (clinical NLP OR biomedical data OR medical AI) (code OR tool OR dataset)
all public repositories, including archived and forks; source-native pagination
(<institution>[Affiliation]) AND (software OR informatics OR imaging OR wearable)

Record exact preprint version and dated affiliation.

queries.rule: Leads only; source-specific access rules, no automatic post collection.

states.pending: not attempted or blocked by qualification
states.complete: all planned pages and followups actually examined with terminal continuation
states.truncated: cap or time limit leaves continuation or required evidence
states.refused: 403, access refusal, rate limit or equivalent; stop, never bypass
states.unknown: unavailable, parser error, missing continuation or ambiguous evidence

stop_and_followup: No retries or access bypass within batch on 403/429/blocked/unavailable. Record actual response and checkpoint, mark incomplete and defer to independently reviewed next manifest. Pending leads persist; no inference of absence or healthy empty.
evidence_per_attempt: exact query or safe URL, date/time and source-native IDs
response outcome and whether indexed or direct
lead counts and disposition with reasons
fact and relationship provenance and unresolved gaps
measures: county x route attempts / planned, with exclusions
account pages exhausted and eligible decisions / explored account pages; incomplete separate
source cluster and user-owned composition among reviewed leads
missingness and pending queue; region-wide denominator unknown
targets: Attempt both routes per county where defensible and permitted; no record quotas; independently review known misses before launch.
exclusions: private sources, credentials, raw source bodies, contact harvesting, protected data, unrestricted post or article reuse
unsupported regional or health claims from name alone; do not discard quiet, archived or paperless projects

request_limits.status: proposed batch limits; not provider maxima
request_limits.content_encoding: identity only; reject any non-identity response
request_limits.pre_retention: Inspect full response shape and every returned field against the approved metadata allowlist and material/rights scope; reject unknown or prohibited fields before any retention.
request_limits.stricter_rule: Exact source preflight or transport may impose lower limits; apply the strictest. Any expansion requires a revised independently reviewed manifest. Reject oversize, compressed, redirect, timeout or malformed response; record outcome as incomplete, not empty.
request_limits.basis: src/ingest/discovery/runtime-contract.ts caps maxResponseBytes at 48000; these additional choices are batch policy and are not claimed to be provider quotas or existing transport behavior.
